label: Называемый
description: A 10-sentence card for называемый, the present passive participle of называть.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Называемый comes from называть — the first-conjugation form называем plus -ый. With так it forms the fixed phrase so-called and agrees with masculine эксперт.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The feminine ending -ая lets называемая agree with свобода. The -ем- suffix marks the first conjugation, and так называемая means the so-called freedom.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Называемое carries the neuter ending -ое to match чудо. As a present passive participle it means the thing being named, here the so-called miracle.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ые lets называемые agree with друзья. The phrase так называемые is a lexicalized formula meaning so-called.

Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the inanimate masculine object адрес the participle keeps называемый as the address we visit. Называемый адрес equals адрес, который называют — the one people name.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive. Называемой takes the feminine genitive ending to agree with реформы, marking the so-called reform as the source of the outcome.

missions.phrase: Мы не верим так называемому другу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative noun другу pulls называемому into the dative -ому ending. The phrase names the so-called friend we distrust.

missions.phrase: Он стал так называемым лидером группы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental. After стал the predicate лидером stands in the instrumental, and называемым takes the matching instrumental ending to agree with the so-called leader.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о так называемом прогрессе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so прогрессе and называемом both take prepositional endings as the so-called progress we discuss.

Strategic focus: Plural nominative paraphrase. Часто называемые причины unfolds as причины, которые часто называют — reasons that people often name. The participle compresses that который-clause into one agreeing word.
